name: What is a toilet flange and why is it important for toilet repair?

mainEntity.name: What is a toilet flange and why is it important for toilet repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: A toilet flange, also known as a closet flange, is a pipe fitting that secures the toilet to the floor and connects it to the drainpipe. It creates a watertight seal, preventing leaks and odors. If the flange is damaged or improperly installed, it can lead to wobbling toilets, water damage to the subfloor, and unsanitary conditions. Ensuring a properly functioning flange is crucial for the stability and hygiene of your bathroom.
acceptedAnswer.description: A toilet flange secures the toilet to the floor and drainpipe, creating a watertight seal to prevent leaks and odors.
